items: Updates are checked before they replace anything, and nothing is replaced while the game runs.
Beta updates in Settings (off unless you switch it on).
Tools > Roll back to previous version.
The guest sees the host's briefing and launch videos, in step.
The guest hears the game's music and the squad's radio.
Your own drone, A.S.F., infrared, full view and 360 view as the guest.
Two players on different versions are told who runs what.
Esc opens Uplink's menu in solo and host: game menu, graphics, options, quit.
Footprints and vehicle tracks from each model.
Ground tiles blend only with their own kind: no sand over concrete.
Smoke grenades drawn from the game's own particles.
Music device and AWE32 ROM on the Settings page.
Beta updates, roll back to the previous version.
